items.text: Mira Alder was discharged to her own home on October 7, 2026, with a follow-up appointment scheduled at Juniper Clinic on October 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM, in person.

citations.quote: SYNTHETIC RECORD. Mira Alder, member SYN-DEMO-001, was discharged on October 7, 2026, to her own home. This document records discharge disposition, not a later home visit.
The discharge coordinator scheduled a follow-up appointment at fictional Juniper Clinic for October 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM. The appointment is listed as in person.

items.text: Transport to the October 12 appointment is arranged via demo ride service with a planned pickup at 9:15 AM from Mira's home, but Mira has not acknowledged this pickup time.

citations.quote: The discharge handoff lists transport to the October 12 clinic appointment as arranged through the fictional demo ride service, with a planned 9:15 AM pickup. The handoff does not record Mira acknowledging that pickup time.

items.text: Mira's adult son, Eli, is listed as a support person who intended to stay at Mira's home through October 10, 2026, but there is no confirmation he arrived or stayed there.

This log contains no direct confirmation that Eli arrived or stayed at the home. The support arrangement remains the plan reported during discharge preparation.

items.text: Mira prefers outreach calls in the morning and prefers the first call be directed to her rather than to Eli.

citations.quote: SYNTHETIC RECORD. During discharge planning, Mira said she expected to return to her own home and preferred outreach in the morning.
